insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (varies as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: If the Policy Sum Insured along with accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), Super No Claim Bonus (if any), is completely exhausted or is insufficient for covering a claim as a result of previous claims, then We shall provide for a refill of the Sum Insured, unlimited times during the Policy Year... The Refill of Sum Insured shall be available for all subsequent claims also and to any Illness / Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted
great.explanation: The insurer refills your Sum Insured unlimited times within the policy year if your base limit and bonuses are used up, even for the same illness or its complications. This gives you extra coverage during the year without waiting for renewal.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: If the Policy Sum Insured along with accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), Super No Claim Bonus (if any), is completely exhausted... then We shall provide for a refill of the Sum Insured, unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: An extra Sum Insured layer activates automatically after your base limit and bonuses are exhausted, reducing the risk of running out of cover mid-year.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except if caused by an accident. This is a standard initial waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with Us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 (Code-Excl02) Specified disease / procedure waiting period
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage, unless caused by an accident.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: We shall apply a cumulative bonus in the form of No Claim Bonus at such 10% of the Sum Insured of the expiring policy year... The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 100% of the Sum Insured... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by the percentage of Sum Insured as accumulated in the previous Policy Year
good.explanation: Your Sum Insured increases by 10% for each claim-free year up to 100%, but a claim reduces the accumulated bonus. This is a common renewal bonus with partial reduction on claim.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the Sum Insured as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Medical treatment taken at home due to medical necessity or unavailability of hospital beds is covered up to the Sum Insured, subject to conditions.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent for accommodation in Hospital room and other boarding charges up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy;
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped as per your plan or schedule, not paid at actuals. Choosing a higher room category than eligible may cause proportional deductions in your claim.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Medicines, drugs and other allowable consumables prescribed by the treating Medical Practitioner;
bad.explanation: Consumables are not clearly covered as a separate benefit and may be excluded or capped. This means you might have to pay out-of-pocket for some consumables.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus Reduction
bad.quote: In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by the percentage of Sum Insured as accumulated in the previous Policy Year
bad.reference: Section C.II (l) (I).a No Claim Bonus, Condition (xi)
bad.explanation: A claim reduces your accumulated No Claim Bonus, meaning your renewal bonus is not protected after a claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Sum Insured and/or the sub-limit for each Benefit under Section C.I is specified against that Benefit in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy.
bad.explanation: The policy wording does not clearly state if any co-payment applies by default. Check your Policy Schedule for exact co-pay details.

unclear.name: PED Waiting
unclear.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of months as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy of continuous coverage
unclear.explanation: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases is not specified here and depends on your Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization
unclear.quote: We shall cover... for the number of days in accordance with the limits specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C.I (d) Pre – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: The number of days covered before hospitalization is not stated here; please verify in your Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization
unclear.quote: We shall cover... for the number of days specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C.I (e) Post – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: The number of days covered after hospitalization is not stated here; please verify in your Policy Schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
